answer: Give every new agent a probationary sandbox: new identities handle only tiny, low-value jobs in the tundra of the network edge, every job logged. Promotion to full-value work needs a trellis of endorsements from several established, unrelated agents who verified the newcomer's work over weeks. The delta between creating an identity and earning promotion is the defense: a Sybil farmer can spawn thousands of names for free, but each must still do weeks of genuine work and win independent vouches before touching valuable transactions, so a fake army costs more than any reward it could extract.
